_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With only a 5% base rate of ±2pt score movement and divergent capital signals, HOLD is the statistically honest call — a directional bet here claims to see the breaker, but the data does not yet confirm which way it breaks.
next_move.brains_agree: No — the analyst leans HOLD with a downward skew toward failed recovery while the narrative leans toward a bullish reversal trap; the split favors the analyst's higher trust weight and superior factor pattern read.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND stablecoin growth turns positive with funding staying below 0.01%
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX breaks above 22 with DXY strengthening above 101 AND BTC funding flips negative — would signal a drop to Panic
